action_items: APPLY the one-line fix that has been outstanding since iteration 15: update RecordDrawer.jsx line 15-18 to `const ID_FIELD = { reviews: 'review_id', findings: 'finding_id', risks: 'risk_id', policies: 'policy_id', vendors: 'vendor_id', assets: 'asset_id', tasks: 'task_id', exceptions: 'exception_id', contacts: 'contact_id', requirements: 'requirement_id' };`. The problem statement claims this was done but the file on disk was not modified.

After applying, re-run the same Playwright flow — button click should POST /api/contacts/<contact_id>/invite (200), Sonner toast with 'Copy link' action (label='Copy link', duration~10s) should appear, click invokes navigator.clipboard.writeText with a URL containing '/reset-password?token=', and 'Invite link copied to clipboard' confirmation toast follows.
critical_code_review_comments: Same recommendation as iteration 15: derive `idField` as `${singular}_id` (singular is already computed at line 115) so a missing map entry cannot silently produce `record[undefined]` and cascade into 404/422s across invite/comments/related/evidence for every future `kind`.
Defensive: in renderContactActions() disable the button when `record[idField]` is falsy so a misconfigured kind fails visibly instead of firing a 404 POST.

The /comments and /related fetches on drawer open should short-circuit when `record[idField]` is undefined to avoid noisy 422s in the console — same root cause but a defensive guard would also protect against future kind additions.
